WITH visible AS (
  SELECT user_id, username, avatar_url, display_name, bio, location, website, is_verified, followers_count, following_count, posts_count, likes_count, created_at
  FROM v_user_profile_public
  WHERE is_active = 1
    AND (:pattern = '%%' OR LOWER(username) LIKE :pattern OR LOWER(display_name) LIKE :pattern OR LOWER(bio) LIKE :pattern)
    AND (:verified_only = 0 OR is_verified = 1)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT visible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN :sort_mode = 'popular' THEN followers_count END DESC,
             CASE WHEN :sort_mode = 'oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,
             CASE WHEN :sort_mode <> 'oldest' THEN created_at END DESC,
             user_id ASC
  ) AS rn
  FROM visible
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id, 0) AS user_id, r.username, r.avatar_url, r.display_name, r.bio, r.location, r.website, r.is_verified, r.followers_count, r.following_count, r.posts_count, r.likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen_at,
       CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, r.user_id) END AS relation, t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visible) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn

SELECT user_id, username, avatar_url, display_name, bio, location, website, is_verified, followers_count, following_count, posts_count, likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen_at,
       fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, u.user_id) AS relation, 0 AS total
FROM v_user_profile_public u
WHERE u.is_active = 1 AND u.user_id <> :viewer_id
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_follows f WHERE f.follower_id = :viewer_id AND f.following_id = u.user_id AND f.status = 'active')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE
       (b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id) OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id))
ORDER BY u.followers_count DESC, u.posts_count DESC, u.created_at DESC, u.user_id ASC
FETCH FIRST :row_limit ROWS ONLY
